name: Coatings and linings
principle: Fusion-bonded epoxy is a thermoset powder applied to hot blast-cleaned steel; it melts and cross-links to protect pipe from corrosion. It is a stand-alone coating or the primer in multi-layer polyolefin systems.

process_steps.name: Heat steel by induction or oven
